sources.observation: Self-description centers Python, bug finding, tool building, lafleur/labeille authorship, fusil maintenance and long CPython contribution/triage history.
Owned non-fork repositories include fuzzing, CPython review/findings and RustPython-targeted audit repositories; names are discovery only.
Real PyPI test-suite runner for target CPython builds with resolve/run/bisect, benchmarks, free-threading and extension compatibility workflows.
Coverage-guided evolutionary fuzzer for CPython JIT with JIT-specific mutators, adaptive scheduling, campaign aggregation and crash triage.
Explicit revival of Victor Stinner's fuzzing framework; active scope centers Python fuzzing while legacy non-Python fuzzers are not claimed.
Catalog reports many distinct bugs across external projects and explicitly discloses that catalog/tooling were assembled with Claude Code.
Claude Code plugin for CPython C review with multiple agents, detectors, campaign slicing and reproduction workflows.
OOM findings include reproducers/backtraces/root-cause writeups; disclosure says Claude Code works alongside the maintainer and the maintainer reviews/re-reproduces every finding before disclosure.
TSan triage/dedupe repository was newly stood up and explicitly had no catalogued findings yet at snapshot.
Subject-authored reversed(dict) OOB crash report with reproducer, path comparison, history analysis and suggested fix; disclosure says reduced/reproduced/drafted with Claude Code assistance.
Subject-authored umbrella issue for 15 free-threading races; Claude Code drafted reports/reduced reproducers, while each reproducer and root cause was re-verified by hand.

scope_boundaries: AI assistance is explicit and must not be erased or over-attributed to the human.
Human reviewing, re-reproduction and source checking remain valid supported roles.
RustPython appearing as an audit target does not establish Rust mastery.
Issue authorship does not imply authorship of linked fixes.
